Answers
vp_panels: Centred window, like the Altar and Stats (simple, but it covers the world while you feed)  | note: All pop up panels should be on the building we interact with.
vp_guidance: Leave as it is (text only)
vp_look: Icons, plus one pixel font (Pixelify Sans) for all text  | note: all UI needs to be consistent.
vp_bar: Icon-only buttons with tooltips; Reset moves into a Help/Settings menu
vp_zoom: The four crisp steps plus one far 'map' step at 120 cells (half size, slight shimmer)
vp_mood: Calmer ground on every island: darker, less saturated, so buildings and resources stand out
vp_props: Check all 26 existing buildings against one reference sheet  | note: All of them look too pixelated/low quality
vp_fishing: Make it a snowy northern fishing island on purpose (snow props, ice at the pond edge)

notes.vp_panels: All pop up panels should be on the building we interact with.
notes.vp_look: all UI needs to be consistent.
notes.vp_props: All of them look too pixelated/low quality

interpretation.vp_panels: The note is the answer: every pop-up panel opens anchored on the building being used (not a centred window).
interpretation.vp_props: Pick + note: review all 26 buildings against one reference sheet; owner finds all of them too pixelated / low quality, so the redo targets higher detail.
